source.title: Hinterlands Mission V: Turtle Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'wath. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Sanathel there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Sanathel in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion behind the drum in Shaol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
